capabilities: review accumulated Untitled notes one at a time
rename or delete each untitled note
bulk delete via a checklist with confirmation
preview rendered Markdown contents before acting
preserve folder and extension when renaming
extras: README states maintenance is best-effort and the plugin has a deliberately narrow scope with no runtime dependencies.
problem: Untitled.md and Untitled 1.md files pile up in vaults and there is no built-in workflow to review and clean them up.
summary: Review tool that finds accumulated Untitled Markdown notes and lets you rename, delete, or keep each one.
